desc:
Welcome to SCP MORPH!
Secure. Contain. Protect.

Updates every Saturday, new content and improvements every week.
Find and unlock 30+ SCP morphs hidden around the facility.

Explore different locations:
- SCP-173 Chamber
- SCP-682 Chamber
- SCP-096 (Shy Guy) Chamber
- Courtyard
- Facility Roof
- TOP SECRET Room
- Guard Rooms
- Personnel Cells
- ???

New morphs every week. Have fun.
Made by the biggest fans of SCP.
